title: Rhythm of the Deep: Two-tier acoustic organization of sperm-whale codas from click waveforms to second-order sequence dependence
abstract: arXiv:2606.16084v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sperm-whale codas are conventionally characterized by click count and inter-click intervals (ICIs), leaving recurring differences in constituent click waveforms unresolved. This study tests whether acoustic organization is nested across two scales: within codas, where recurring click-waveform differences may complement ICI timing, and across codas, where recurring whole-coda forms may themselves carry sequence dependence. Candidate recurring click and whole-coda groupings were identified from 1,483 codas without prespecifying waveform categories, then evaluated with native-rate spectral/envelope measurements, exact nuisance matching, held-out timing contrasts, and sequence controls. At the first tier, recurring click-waveform groups differed in spectral slope, bandwidth, flatness, high/low-band energy, and envelope structure within matched date, social unit, individual, and sample-rate strata. translated_title: 深海之韵：从点击声波形到二阶序列依赖的抹香鲸尾音两级声学组织
translated_abstract: 抹香鲸尾音（codas）通常以点击声数量和点击间隔（ICI）来刻画，但其组成点击声波形中反复出现的差异一直未能得到解释。本研究检验了声学组织是否在两个尺度上呈嵌套结构：在尾音内部，反复出现的点击声波形差异可能与ICI时间信息互补；在尾音之间，反复出现的整体尾音形式本身可能携带序列依赖性。研究从1,483个尾音中识别出候选的反复出现的点击声和整体尾音分组，且未预先指定波形类别，随后通过原始采样率的频谱/包络测量、精确的干扰因素匹配、留出的时序对比以及序列控制进行评估。在第一层级，在匹配的日期、社会单元、个体和采样率层级内，反复出现的点击声波形组在频谱斜率、带宽、平坦度、高/低频带能量和包络结构上均存在差异。其组成增加了关于……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现抹香鲸尾音的声学组织具有两级嵌套结构：尾音内部反复出现的点击声波形差异与点击间隔时间互补，而尾音之间反复出现的整体尾音形式本身携带序列依赖性。
en_tdlr: This study reveals a two-tier nested acoustic organization in sperm-whale codas, where recurring click-waveform differences complement ICI timing within codas, and recurring whole-coda forms themselves carry second-order sequence dependence across codas.
